scientific_integrity: Infinite quantifiers established by a four-block induction; finite verification is corroborative only. No independent external audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the ordinary binary Thue-Morse sum along multiples of 3. Does not classify all maximizing indices or prove extensions to other moduli. Older exact Coquet formulas could yield related extrema upon nontrivial further analysis, and the full original Coquet text could not be inspected.
title: Sharp quartic-shell extrema of the Newman rarefied Thue–Morse sum
